text: Colgrevance was a knight of the Round Table in the story of Owein and the Lady of the Fountain. He was the first knight to meet the guardian of the chosen of the fountain. That dour Black Knight was the husband of the lady. He beat Colgrevance, who went home to Camelot with the tale. The tale stirred Owein to do the Black Knight now.

okr.objective: Colgrevance meets the Black Knight first and brings the tale that spurs Owein.
key_results: Colgrevance is a knight of the Round Table.
He is the first to meet the fountain's Black Knight guardian.
His tale stirs Owein to act.
